name: SUFFER
desc:
New map, more skins, more weapons and more stuff

FIGHT with a range of WEAPONS and GUNS in absolute CHAOS. Use a SWORD or an AXE or a CHAINSAW or CHEETOS in COMBAT to deal PAIN. 

Do you want to become a STRONG WARRIOR, a true GOD? Of course you do... So you know the answer to the next question.

To suffer or to give suffering... Which will you choose?

Group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/4450727/Insomnious#!/about

Controls:
- Pick-up Ragdoll: F
- Sprint: SHIFT
- Reload: R
- Flip: E
- Shiftlock: CTRL

Inspired by Mortem Metallum, Chaos, Pain and Combat Warriors.
